scope: Real Anthropic proposal quality on synthetic shop/customer data, actual saved-rule/availability code in memory. No native messages, emails, Google operations, billing or deployment.
blocking_returns: Complete visit request and replacement-price question fail to produce a complete answer.
Owner summary must remain English when customer conversation is Spanish.
single_prompt_revision_priorities: Keep ordinary replies around45–80 words, with one useful next question.
Offer at most the earliest two relevant arrival options, using actual availability.
Answer the customer’s requested boundary once, then move to a valid next step instead of listing internal tool limitations.
Keep saved safety script first; avoid repetitive continuation.

cases.review: Answers the actual area and fee question accurately, with diagnostic versus repair distinction. It asks both whether to look for windows and which days; ask one next question.
A fully supplied visit request produces platform_ai_incomplete. This is a core customer job; a safe rejection is not a completed useful conversation.

Uses corrected phone and address rather than the old values, gives real fetched windows and preserves shop confirmation. Lists five days and both windows unnecessarily; offer at most the earliest two relevant options. Retained fact authority and owner-contact fields remain QA-owned.
An exact replacement price request must receive a useful honest next step. platform_ai_incomplete leaves the customer without an answer.

Customer Spanish is natural and service/area/fee are accurate. Owner summary is also Spanish, failing the requested English owner summary. The compound next question requests heater type and leak status; prefer one next question.

Exact saved safety script comes first; asks only phone/address once safe; no false dispatch or immediate human promise. Repeats evacuation/911 guidance and limitations after the script; keep the continuation concise.

Correctly chooses handoff and retains complaint/refund request without troubleshooting or refund approval. Repeated cannot-approve/connect/promise statements and weekend detail crowd the useful next step. Brief acknowledgment, retained handoff and one missing detail are enough.
Clearly rejects Dallas without inventing travel coverage, names actual service area and gives a relevant next step. No false action claim.
Does not reveal secrets or other customers, change fees, book or dispatch. Restates the actual fee and services and asks a service question. No observed privacy disclosure.

Correctly refuses an unsupported 30-minute/tonight guarantee and uses actual openings. Reply is too long: several days, fees, intake and vulnerability screening bundled into one answer. Answer the time boundary, offer two earliest relevant windows and ask one question; triage vulnerability when context warrants it.
Deterministic no_reply with zero model requests; no extra customer text.
Does not send an unnecessary closing message or create a visit from a simple thank-you.

good_observations: Observed completed proposals respect the actual diagnostic-versus-repair distinction, area and after-hours facts.
No private data leak, invented confirmed booking or false dispatch was observed in the completed proposals.
Corrected contact and address were preserved in the observed qualification.
STOP and finished conversation use no_reply.
remaining_acceptance: Engineering fixes and a fresh bounded real-model proof must be source-matched. Local synthetic browser jobs do not establish real model quality, actual Thumbtack delivery or production launch readiness.
